hero.title:
Every step
deserves to be kept.
hero.sub: Real races across Cambodia: registration, results, photos and the runners' community.
hero.imageAlt: Runners on the Phnom Penh riverside at sunrise

how.title: How registration works
how.step1: Pick a race and a category
how.step3: Pay by QR and upload the receipt
how.note: Once finance confirms the payment, you'll hear back on Telegram.

events.title: All events
events.empty: No events are open right now

event.share_failed: Couldn't copy — copy the address bar instead

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The link may be out of date.

pay.title: Payment
pay.scanQr: Open your banking app and scan the QR code above
pay.amountHintIdent: Please transfer exactly this amount. The odd cents ({{cents}}¢ off) help us identify your order.
pay.orderNo: Put this order number in the transfer note
pay.expired: The payment window has closed and this order will expire. If you already paid, contact support.

proof.title: Upload payment proof
proof.intro: Upload a screenshot of the successful transfer and enter the transaction reference.
proof.fileHelp: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB
proof.txnRefHelp: The Transaction ID or Reference on your bank receipt

error.fileType: Only JPG, PNG or WebP images are accepted
error.fileTooLarge: The image must be 5 MB or smaller
error.txnRefLength: The transaction reference must be 4–64 characters, not counting spaces
error.amountInvalid: Enter an amount above 0 with at most two decimals
error.paidAtInvalid: The payment time is not valid

serverError.ORDER_EXPIRED: This order has expired. Please register again.
serverError.PROOF_TXN_REF_USED: This transaction reference has already been submitted. Check it and try again.
serverError.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The image is larger than 5 MB. Compress it and try again.
serverError.FILE_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED: We couldn't read this image. Upload a JPG, PNG or WebP screenshot.
serverError.ORDER_STATE_CONFLICT: Proof can't be uploaded for this order right now. Refresh to see its status.

openInTelegram.title: Open in Telegram
openInTelegram.body: Registration and saved runners are available in the WeRun mini app on Telegram. You can still browse events here. You can also log in with your phone number.

phone.title: Log in with phone
phone.intro: We'll send a verification code through Telegram to the account linked to this phone number.
phone.orTelegram: You can also open the WeRun mini app in Telegram — no code needed.
phone.sendFailed: Couldn't send the code. Please try again.
phone.verifyFailed: Couldn't log in. Please try again.

me.title: My account
me.displayNameHint: Used for greetings and notifications; it doesn't change your runner profiles.

profiles.title: Saved runners
profiles.empty: No saved runners yet. Runners saved here can be picked when you register.
profiles.idNoKeepHint: Current ID number {{masked}}. Leave blank to keep it.

fields.nationalityHint: Two-letter country code, e.g. KH or CN

register.title: Register: {{event}}
register.closed: Registration for this event is not open.

errors.tooYoung: Must be at least {{minAge}} on race day.
errors.duplicateProfile: This runner has already been added.
errors.duplicateIdNo: Another runner in this order has the same ID number.
errors.network: Network problem. Please check your connection and try again.
errors.tooSlow: You need a time of {{max}} or faster for this category.
errors.urlFormat: Enter a link starting with https:// or http://.

quote.title: Estimated price
quote.identNote: This is an estimate. When you place the order, 1–50 cents are taken off so we can match your transfer. The exact amount to transfer is shown after you place the order.

qualify.proofHint: An official results page or certificate. The organizer checks it after payment.
qualify.fallback: If it can't be verified you'll be moved to {{category}} and stay registered.

orders.title: My events

amount.identHint: Taken off so we can match your transfer.

orders.cancelAsk: Cancel this order? Your spots will be released.

panel.reviewing: Your proof is in. Finance usually reviews it within 24 hours and we'll notify you on Telegram.
panel.paid: Your registration is confirmed. Show the ticket below on race day.
panel.expired: This order has expired and the spots were released.

free.title: Free sign-up
free.phoneInvalid: Enter a phone number with the country code, e.g. +85512345678
free.tooYoung: Must be at least {{minAge}} years old on race day
free.alreadyRegistered: This name and phone number are already signed up for this category
free.closed: Registration for this activity is not open

footer.tagline: Running races in Cambodia, from registration to results.

routeError.title: Something went wrong
routeError.body: This page hit an unexpected error. Reload to try again, or go back to the home page.

registerLeave.title: Leave registration?
registerLeave.body: The runner details you've entered on this page will be lost.

referral.title: Referral link
referral.invalid: This referral link is disabled or doesn't exist. You can still register directly.

offer.price: Referral price {{price}} per runner, locked in

comp.title: Request complimentary entry
comp.entryTitle: KOL, run club captain, sponsor or media?
comp.entryHint: Request complimentary entry. Once approved you get a personal free registration code.
comp.intro: The organizer looks at your profile or club and usually replies within 48 hours. Once approved, your free code appears here. It is for you only, 1 runner.
comp.name: Name or handle
comp.profileUrlHint: Instagram, TikTok, Facebook or your club's Telegram group
comp.closed: This event isn't accepting complimentary entry requests.
comp.pendingHint: The result will show here once the organizer reviews it.
comp.approved: Approved. Here is your free registration code:
comp.approvedHint: For you only, 1 runner per order. It is filled in automatically when you register.

refund.title: Refunds and transfers
refund.howTo: To get a refund or transfer, contact support from your order page. The rate depends on the day you ask.
